_prompt_descriptive_v0: In the Pi agent, capturing a session transcript builds a destination file path directly from the hook-supplied session ID. A crafted ID containing traversal segments like "../" can write the transcript outside the intended .entire/tmp/pi cache directory. Close this hole where the ID first becomes a path, matching the existing 'no capture' signal so downstream dispatch is unaffected. Keep the fix minimal.
